THE GOLDEN RULES BUILT INTO THIS WORKBOOK
1. Local = singles & 2-packs, no delivery, 73.9% margin.
2. Online = packs only, always with 35 DH delivery.
3. Never advertise single bottles — ads are for packs only.
4. Never let Class A stock run out — reorder at 8 bottles left, no negotiating.
5. Budget 35 DH delivery into every online order.
6. Budget 15% returns on online orders.
7. Drop Class C parfums after 2 bad months; replace with what customers ask for.
8. Make batches based on real sales data, not guesses.
9. Track Local and Online channels separately — different margins.
10. Maceration is not optional — 14 days minimum, plan 3 weeks ahead.
11. Sellable stock ≠ total stock — macerating bottles don't count.
12. 50ml is a promo tool, not a standalone product — pack upgrade only (249 DH+).
